# Atom Shop Update 07/08/2025

![Atom Shop Update 07/08/2025](/uploads/537_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

#### Free items

Stir well, otherwise there will be lumps! The Concrete Mixer is free for all Fallout 1st members until August 5th!

The Pink Suit is free for all players until July 15th.

| **Item** | **Available until** | 
| Concrete mixer | August 5th | 
| Pink suit | July 15 | 

Grab something free in the Atomic Shop this week too. Each item is always available until **18:00 CEST** the following day.

| **Item** | **Available on** | 
| Bottle caps x 250 | July 8th | 
| Carrying capacity booster | July 9th | 
| Lunchbox | July 10 | 
| “Recycle and store” kit | July 11th | 
| Improved Lure x 5 | July 12 | 
| Lunchbox | June 13th | 
| Repair kit | July 14th | 

#### Weekly offers

This week the Atomic Shop is back with daily offers! Each item is always available until 6:00 p.m. CEST the following day.

| **Item** | **Atoms** | **Available from** | **Available until** | 
| **Artisan Pack (Fallout 1st)** | ~~1,500~~ 1,125 (-25%) | July 8th | July 15 | 
| Death Tambourine Paint (Bone Tambourine) | ~~500~~ 250 (-50%) | July 8th | July 9th | 
| Gatling Gun Paint (Appalachia Blunderbuss) | ~~500~~ 250 (-50%) | July 9th | July 10 | 
| Combat Knife Paint (Free States) | ~~500~~ 250 (-50%) | July 10 | July 11th | 
| Superhammer (Grognak's Warclub) | ~~500~~ 250 (-50%) | July 11th | July 12 | 
| Machine Gun Paint (Vault-Tec) | ~~500~~ 250 (-30%) | July 12 | July 13th | 
| Automatic Ax Paint (Fanatic) | ~~500~~ 250 (-50%) | July 13th | July 14th | 
| Nighthawk Skin (The Dragon) | ~~400~~ 200 (-50%) | July 14th | July 15 | 

#### Fallout 1st deals with special discount

A few of our favorite items have returned to the Atomic Shop for Fallout 1st members!

| **Item** | **Atoms** | 
| Fallout 1st Year Catch-up Pack 3 | 4,000 | 
| Fallout 1st Quarter Catch-up Pack 15 | 1,000 |

| Fallout 1st Catch-up Pack Casino Jackpot | 1,500 | 
| Fallout 1st Catch-up Pack Casino Gangster | 1,800 | 
| Player titles [Fallout] and [1st] | FREE with Fallout 1st |
